stories.title: Option Deadline Incoming — Assad, Rea, Boyd, Harvey by Oct 5
stories.angle: The Cubs have 5 days to make roughly $40M in option decisions. Assad ($3.3M club) and Rea ($7.5M club) should be exercised — these are low-cost depth pieces. Boyd ($15M mutual) and Harvey ($8M mutual) are almost certainly declined. Knowing which relievers/starters are returning is crucial context for how narrow (or wide) the rotation rebuild market needs to be.

stories.title: Kevin Alcántara Is Ready and Waiting

The question is what roster he's stepping into — and whether the Cubs build around him or continue trading prospects.
